title: ProvenExpert Reviews & DACH Reputation Monitor
description: Extract ProvenExpert, Trusted Shops, eKomi, and Google Maps reputation data; match profiles; calculate trust scores, deltas, and sector benchmarks.

startUrls.title: Review profile URLs
startUrls.description: ProvenExpert, Trusted Shops, eKomi, or Google Maps business profile URLs. At the Free tier checked on 6 October 2026, delivered business rows cost $0.02, profile rows $0.0075, change rows $0.02 and review rows $0.001. Invalid or blocked profiles produce error rows with no custom result-event charge; the memory-based Actor start can still apply. Live Pricing is authoritative.

businesses.title: Cross-platform businesses
businesses.description: Optional explicit company groups. URLs in the same object are guaranteed to be matched into one business row.

id.title: Stable business ID
id.description: Your optional stable identifier for this business.

companyName.title: Company name
companyName.description: Preferred company name used in the matched business row.

category.title: Benchmark category
category.description: Sector label used to select comparable businesses.

city.title: City
city.description: Optional city label for this business.

trustedShopsUrl.title: Trusted Shops URL
trustedShopsUrl.description: Public Trusted Shops business profile URL.

searchQueries.title: ProvenExpert company discovery
searchQueries.description: Discover public ProvenExpert profiles by sector/keyword and optional location. Results become the benchmark cohort.

term.title: Sector or keyword
term.description: The service, sector, or keyword to search on ProvenExpert.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional city or region for the ProvenExpert search.

maxProfiles.title: Maximum profiles
maxProfiles.description: Maximum discovered profiles to process for this query.

locale.title: ProvenExpert locale
locale.description: Locale used for slugs and non-localized ProvenExpert URLs.

outputMode.title: Raw output mode
outputMode.description: Business and change rows are controlled separately below. This option controls raw profile/review rows.

maxReviewsPerProfile.title: Maximum reviews per profile
maxReviewsPerProfile.description: Maximum native reviews saved per ProvenExpert, Trusted Shops, or eKomi profile. Google Maps currently returns aggregate reputation fields.

sortBy.title: Review sorting
sortBy.description: Order used when the source supports sorting.

followExternalProfiles.title: Follow linked external profiles
followExternalProfiles.description: Open supported Trusted Shops, eKomi, and Google Maps links found on ProvenExpert and refresh their aggregate data directly.

discoverExternalProfilesFromWebsite.title: Discover review badges on company websites
discoverExternalProfilesFromWebsite.description: Visit only the company homepage and follow supported ProvenExpert, Trusted Shops, eKomi, or Google Maps profile links found in anchors and badge iframes.

includeBusinessSummary.title: Create cross-platform business rows
includeBusinessSummary.description: Match profiles and emit one business row with all channels and the DACH Trust Score.

emitChanges.title: Create change rows
emitChanges.description: Compare each business with its latest stored or supplied snapshot. A first observation only creates the baseline; when a grouped source fails, the change row reports it as unknown and suppresses deltas instead of guessing.

changesOnly.title: Output changes only
changesOnly.description: Suppress unchanged business/profile rows and reviews already present in the previous snapshot.

saveHistory.title: Save time-series snapshots
saveHistory.description: Append compact time-series snapshots and maintain an indexed latest-state store for fast future comparisons.

historyDatasetName.title: History dataset name
historyDatasetName.description: Persistent named dataset used for automatic time-series comparisons.

previousDatasetId.title: Previous snapshot dataset ID or name
previousDatasetId.description: Optional explicit baseline. When empty, the named history dataset is used.

benchmarkDatasetId.title: Benchmark dataset ID or name
benchmarkDatasetId.description: Optional dataset containing business, business_snapshot, or profile rows to enlarge the benchmark cohort.

minimumBenchmarkCohortSize.title: Minimum benchmark cohort
minimumBenchmarkCohortSize.description: Minimum comparable businesses required before a benchmark is marked ready.

ratingChangeThreshold.title: Rating change threshold
ratingChangeThreshold.description: Minimum absolute rating movement counted as a change. Review count changes always count.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Profiles processed in parallel. Keep this moderate for stable crawling.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy configuration. Direct connections are used by default; enable proxy rotation if Google or another source blocks your cloud region.
